raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "The patch adds a labelled optional Note textarea with maxLength 500 (and labels Name and Phone). The API trims the note, stores empty or whitespace-only notes as NULL, keeps inner line breaks, and rejects notes over 500 characters through the zod schema. The admin card shows the note as escaped plain text with whitespace-pre-wrap. The one gap I can see is that zod and maxLength count UTF-16 code units, so emoji-heavy notes hit the limit early, and I judged that too minor to fail the patch."}
